_doc: THE (FAMILY, FIELD) PAIRS THAT MUST CARRY NON-DEFAULT VECTORS.
Read by scripts/check_default_variance.py. Nothing else consumes it.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A read-only census of 446 fixture files / 1,751
vectors on 2026-08-02 found seven dimensions frozen corpus-wide, and every
frozen constant equals EXACTLY the struct default -- verified field by
field against CommonProps::default(). Fixtures are authored by
CONSTRUCTING a document, so they inherit the constructor. A corpus whose
every value IS the default cannot distinguish a dropped field from a
preserved one, which is the banked Swift copy-site omission class seen
from the other end: one writes the default in, the other cannot tell that
it was written in.
AND THE VARIANCE THAT EXISTS IS CAMPAIGN RESIDUE. The cross-tab is
near-diagonal -- `transform` varies only under transform_*, `locked` only
under lock_*, `stroke` only under set_* -- and the two fields varied
everywhere, `name` and `fill`, are precisely the two that had dedicated
campaigns. The corpus varies where we once looked. That predicts the next
blind spot exactly: any field that never had a campaign.
SO THE GATE ITERATES THIS FILE, NOT THE CORPUS. Walking the fields you
happen to find would miss the field nobody varied, which is the entire
defect. Same inversion as checker_lane_registry.json, same reason.
TO ADD AN OBLIGATION: one row, a `min`, and a `reason` naming what it buys
that no other row does. Adding is deliberately CHEAP -- `min` is a floor,
not an exact count, because every extra carrier is progress and should
never red an unrelated change.
TO DROP ONE: delete the row and lower `min_obligations` in the same
commit, in a message saying which pair stops being able to tell a dropped
field from a preserved one, and why that is acceptable. That sentence is
the whole mechanism; nothing here can stop someone who means it.
KEYS ARE 'family|field'. A family is <fixture-subdirectory>/<leading token
of the file name>, with a trailing _expected stripped -- the same grouping
the census's own sentences use.

operations/transform|transform.reason: THE ONLY PLACE IN THE CORPUS WHERE A TRANSFORM IS NON-DEFAULT. 90.6% of elements carry none, and outside transform_* the figure is 100%: 11 of these documents against 0 of the other 172 measured. If this family goes flat, `transform: null` becomes universal and no fixture anywhere can separate a port that preserves the transform from a port that drops it on a copy -- which is exactly what a field-by-field rebuild at a Swift copy site does.

operations/transform|id.reason: Element identity UNDER AN EDIT THAT REWRITES GEOMETRY. The preservation law says an edit changes what it speaks to and preserves the rest; a transform speaks to geometry, so the id is the thing it must not touch. This is the largest id-bearing family and the only one where identity has to survive a coordinate rewrite rather than a structural move.

operations/bystander|id.reason: The bystander clause's own family: ids that must survive an edit aimed at somebody else. Small (3 documents, 12 id-bearing slots) and therefore the first to be lost to a fixture cleanup, and it is the only family whose entire point is that the id of an UNTOUCHED element is checked.

operations/lock|locked.reason: The lock-inheritance ruling (LAYER_STRUCTURE.md 13). This family could not exist before LOCKSVG taught the SVG codec to round-trip common.locked -- until then no shared fixture could START from a locked document, which is exactly why the corpus stayed green over an enforcement gap that wide. Losing these carriers restores that hole.

operations/paste|locked.reason: A SECOND VERB. operations/lock alone would make `locked` a one-campaign field, and the census's whole point is that the corpus varies only where a campaign once looked. Paste/duplicate rewrites elements wholesale rather than flipping a flag, so it is the family that can see a copy site rebuilding an element and forgetting the flag -- a different failure from the one lock_* watches.

operations/set|stroke.reason: Stroke is null in 753 of 758 slots corpus-wide. set_* is the family that actually paints one, and with 7 carriers over 8 slots it is the densest stroke evidence in the tree. If it collapses, `stroke: null` is universal and a dropped stroke is indistinguishable from an unstroked element.

gestures/draw|stroke.reason: The same field through the OTHER DRIVER. An op-only corpus is structurally blind to what a tool commits -- the argument the preservation corpus already accepted when it grew a gesture arm. These documents are produced by replaying pointer input through the real tool, so they can see a stroke that the op vocabulary writes and the tool path does not.

actions/fill|stroke.reason: A third stroke family, and the only one reached through the ACTION layer rather than through ops or gestures. Three doors, three chances to notice; two of them are the ones the equivalence directive says to pin.

gestures/blob|tool_origin.reason: tool_origin is non-default in 10 slots in the entire corpus and is set by exactly one tool. It is also a CommonProps field ADDED AFTER most copy sites were written, which is the precise shape check_swift_copy_sites.py exists for: the compiler cannot enumerate the sites, so only a fixture that carries a non-default value can. Losing this family retires the only evidence that blob-brush provenance survives anything.

gestures/recorded|tool_origin.reason: The second and last tool_origin family. Two families is the difference between 'this field is exercised' and 'one fixture happens to set it'; with only 10 non-default slots corpus-wide there is no third to fall back on.

operations/paste|visibility.reason: THE ONLY CELL IN THE CORPUS WITH THREE VISIBILITY CARRIERS -- 10 non-default slots exist in total, across 1043. Visibility is the eye-button cycle's field and carries a banked 2-2 cross-port divergence (deselect-on-invisible), so a corpus that cannot see it written cannot referee that divergence at all. Zero headroom by construction: this row is the whole population.

input_scripts/gradient.stop|fill_gradien.reason: A gradient's STOPS under a panel edit. Both stop scripts edit one stop of the seeded gradient (opacity 50, location 30) through the stop combos, and each read-back keeps the rest of the gradient; a stop edit that dropped or rebuilt the gradient would leave the family at its default.

_doc: WHAT IS NOT PAYABLE TODAY, WITH ITS MEASUREMENT, so the number is visible
rather than forgotten. 321 of 396 populated (family x field) cells hold
fewer than three non-default carriers. Reding all of them would mean
authoring hundreds of fixtures, and the tree is held for a regeneration
of ~103 goldens besides.
EVERY ROW HERE IS EXACT, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. An obligation is a floor
because adding a carrier must stay cheap; debt is the opposite -- its job
is to keep an unpaid number honest. If a measurement moves toward health
someone paid part of the debt without noticing and the row must be
promoted to an obligation or restated; if it moves away, the corpus
thinned where it was already thin. Either way the gate says so instead of
the number rotting.
`improves` SAYS WHICH WAY HEALTH LIES, and it is required. The first cut
of the gate assumed 'up is better', which is right for families_varying:*
and exactly backwards for thin_cells (a count of BLIND cells): it
reported a corpus that had just lost a lock family as PAID DOWN. A red
pointing the wrong way is worse than no red, because someone acts on it.

_doc: CENSUS FINDINGS THIS GATE'S PRIMITIVE CANNOT EXPRESS, listed so the
omission is visible rather than implied by silence. Each would need a
different instrument, not another row above.
out_of_reach.no_negative_determinant: No transform anywhere in the corpus has a negative determinant -- there is no mirror and no flip in the entire tree. P1 counts whether a field is non-default, never what the value MEANS, so a corpus of 500 translate-only transforms scores identically to one that mirrors. Needs a value-predicate instrument.
out_of_reach.square_boxes: 646 of 771 boxes are square. Squareness is a RELATION between width and height, not a field, so it has no struct default to differ from.
out_of_reach.equal_radii: 638 of 686 rx/ry pairs are equal. Same shape as square_boxes, and additionally rx/ry have no derivable default at all: RectElem has no Default impl, so there is no source to read one from.
out_of_reach.colour_space: rgb 707 to cmyk 1. Colour lives inside Fill/Stroke, so P1 sees one non-default `fill` slot and nothing about the space, the channel values or the alpha. Stroke has the same interior problem, recorded on its debt row.
out_of_reach.semantically_inert_values: A transform of scale(1,1) is non-default and means nothing. This gate would score it as a carrier and an obligation could be satisfied by eleven of them.
out_of_reach.per_port_defaults: Defaults are read from the Rust source only. A Swift or Python default that differs would make this gate classify the corpus against the wrong baseline, silently and in agreement with itself.
out_of_reach.collinearity: A family whose documents all descend from one setup SVG can satisfy a floor with N copies of one situation. This is a population count, exactly like min_rulable_vectors, and it was min_witnesses' failure too: it went GREEN on twelve identical copies of one gradient_remap vector. CONFIRMED AGAINST THIS GATE, not inherited: on 2026-08-02 operations/transform was rewritten as seventeen byte-identical copies of transform_rotate_ref_center_expected.json plus one other document -- one distinct content hash across seventeen of eighteen files -- and the whole board stayed GREEN, both obligations satisfied and the debt unmoved. P1 counts CARRIERS, and a replica is a carrier. Anyone reading a satisfied floor here should read it as 'N documents carry a non-default value', never as 'N situations were tried'.
out_of_reach.unwatched_element_fields: 77 fields on the 15 structs an Element can BE are outside the vocabulary (measured 2026-10-16): a field enters only via CommonProps or by being Option-typed, and everything else -- PathElem::fill_rule, GroupElem/LayerElem::isolated_blending and ::knockout_group, width_points, the 21-field TextElem typography block -- is plain-typed on a struct with no Default impl, so there is no default to differ from. This is the gate's own thesis pointed at the gate: those are precisely the never-had-a-campaign fields. Only the COUNT is fixed (UNWATCHED_ELEMENT_FIELDS, pinned exact in the self-test), because MIN_DERIVED_DEFAULTS only notices the vocabulary shrinking and a plain-typed addition moves neither number -- two of the three ways to add a field force a ruling and the third used to arrive in silence. Measuring them needs Default impls on the Elem structs, which is a Rust change, not a gate change.
out_of_reach.depth_within_a_document: A document counts as a carrier when ANY applicable element in it holds a non-default value. A family of eight documents each with 300 elements, one of which carries a transform, scores eight -- the same as eight documents that are non-default throughout. The primitive sees a family's breadth and never its density.
